description_sq:
Ne nje nga projektet me te reja ne Tirane, Lana Riverside Residences disponojm apartament 1+1+ Ballkone. 
Apartaementi ndodhet ne katin e 7, te parafundit, dhe ka nje siperfaqe bruto 107.9 m2 nga te cilat 83 m2 neto. 
Disponojme poste parkimi ne -4 me cmime ekstra ( 40.000 euro )
Location shume i mire, buze bulevardit "Gjergj Fishta".
Per nje vizit ne prone na kontaktoni tani!
description_en: In one of the newest projects in Tirana, Lana Riverside Residences, we have a 1+1+ Balcony apartment. The apartment is located on the 7th, penultimate floor, and has a gross area of ​​107.9 m2, of which 83 m2 is net. We have parking spaces in -4 with extra prices (40,000 euros) Very good location, on the edge of "Gjergj Fishta" boulevard. For a visit to the property, contact us now!
